# 跨步的同一：名字不承载任何东西，每一步与每个条件只由关系确定，追随形成的读法依赖谁延续谁，连续之外剩下接续 / Identity across steps: names carry nothing, each step and each condition are fixed by relations, readings that follow a formation depend on who continues whom, and continuity leaves succession

## 主张 Claim

依存网用固定的索引类型给形成命名，一步的哪个形成与下一步的哪个形成相同由名字规定。改认在每一步把两种命名一一对应，保持每一步的水平、活动、依存与汲取；每一步都相同的改认是改名。改名保持追随形成的读法：形成在整段上更新或消耗、依存的任期、侵蚀、依存的形成与消解、生起与不息。任何改认保持每一步的支持、保持与断裂，每个条件被更新、被消耗或失去，活动是否只在有支持处，每个事件是否在更新之内与是否断裂；改认一个流，保持每步的取用与给予、消耗与补充的平衡、取用者与补充者的数目，因而保持不止地更多；活跃形成的普查与“只有活跃的形成取用”也保持，所以在它们之下，不止地更多在每个改认下蕴含不息：它所迫使的生起不是命名的产物。只改动谁延续谁（每一奇数步交换名字），一个更新、一个消耗的形成变成两个消耗、没有更新；第一步之后汲取者每步侵蚀，变成没有任何事件侵蚀；没有依存形成也没有生起，变成一个形成转化依存、形成在每一奇数步生起，生成不息，而这些生起不降低任何条件，消耗前提 Depletes 不成立。保持跨步持续活动的形成的名字，改认不制造生起，因而不制造不息；保持跨步持续依存的形成的名字，改认使形成在一段任期上只有一个名字，保持在任期中满足过的依存，不去掉侵蚀。这样的改认仍可把在某步终结的形成与在该步开始的形成接起来（接续）：谱系的两个成员交替活跃，分开命名时不息地生起，合为一个命名时始终活跃、没有生起；继承者从长者需要终止的一步起需要同一条件，分开命名时长者失去之后的汲取不侵蚀，继承者接续长者时每一步都侵蚀。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 / A web names its formations by a fixed index type, so which formation at one step is the same as which at the next is stipulated by the names. A re-identification relates two namings one to one at each step and keeps every step's levels, activity, dependences and drawing; a renaming is a re-identification that is the same at every step. A renaming preserves the readings that follow a formation: renewing or consuming in the run, the tenure of a dependence, undermining, forming and dissolving of dependences, arising and unceasing generation. Every re-identification preserves each step's support, keeping and breaking, whether each condition is renewed, consumed or lost, whether activity occurs only where supported, and whether each event is within renewal and whether it breaks; re-identifying a flow preserves what is taken and given at each step, the balance of depletion and replenishment, and the numbers of takers and renewers, so more without end; a census of the active formations and that only active formations take carry over too, so under them more without end makes generation unceasing under every re-identification: the arising it forces is not an artefact of naming. Changing only who continues whom (exchanging names at every odd step), a renewing and a consuming formation become two consuming and none renewing; a drawer undermining at every step after the first becomes a web in which no event then undermines; a web in which no dependence forms and nothing arises becomes one in which a formation transforms its dependence and formations arise at every odd step, so that generation is unceasing, though these arisings lower no condition and the depletion premise Depletes fails. Keeping the names of formations active across a step, a re-identification makes no arising, hence no unceasing generation; keeping the names of formations whose dependence continues across a step, it gives a formation one name over a tenure, keeps every dependence met while it held, and removes no undermining. Such a re-identification can still join a formation that ends at a step with one that begins there (succession): two members of a lineage active at alternate steps arise without end when named apart and are always active with nothing arising when named as one; an heir needing the same condition from the step at which an elder's need ends makes drawing after the elder's loss undermine nothing when named apart and undermine at every step when it succeeds the elder. No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 改认在每一步是一一对应；分裂与合并改变形成的数目，不在其中。 / A re-identification is one to one at each step; splits and merges change the number of formations and are not covered.
- 连续读作：跨一步持续活动的形成保持名字（KeepsActive），跨一步持续依存于某条件的形成保持名字（KeepsTenure）。这是作者的读法，不是同一的定义。 / Continuity is read as: formations active across a step keep their names (KeepsActive), and formations whose dependence on a condition continues across a step keep their names (KeepsTenure). This is the author's reading, not a definition of identity.
- 流的改认按每步一一对应改写 present；present 每步只列每个参与的形成一次仍是对应前提。 / Re-identifying a flow rewrites present one to one at each step; that present lists each formation taking part once per step remains a correspondence premise.
- More.unceasing_reidentified 用 more-needs-renewers 的普查、present 不重复与 Taking，以及活跃的可判定性（定理的假设，不是公理）。 / More.unceasing_reidentified uses the census, present without repetition and Taking of more-needs-renewers, and decidable activity (a hypothesis of the theorem, not an axiom).

开放纲领与 becoming-dependence-dynamics 的下一步把形成的个体化列为待做：终止与转化之分依赖外给的同一。本结果陈述这一外给的同一在哪些读法中起作用：每一步与每个条件的读法不依赖它，追随形成的读法依赖它；活动与依存的连续排除制造生起与去掉侵蚀，接续仍由读法决定。作者由此论证（AI 论证）：“生生不息”若读作谱系的持续，落在维持与更新上，若读作成员不断生起，落在不息的生成上；继承者是否继承长者的损失，决定此后的汲取在工作读法下是否侵蚀。两者都是 Ren 的读法选择，不由每一步的关系决定。改名不变也是方法要求“不能以分别命名偷渡独立本体”在这一表示中的一个检查，不是一元的证明。 / The open programme and the next step of becoming-dependence-dynamics list the individuation of formations: the distinction between ending and transformation depends on a supplied identity. This result states in which readings that supplied identity matters: readings of each step and each condition do not depend on it, readings that follow a formation do; continuity of activity and dependence rules out making arising and removing undermining, and succession remains a reading. The author argues from it (an AI argument) that 生生不息 read as a lineage's continuation falls under maintenance and renewal, and read as members arising without end falls under unceasing generation; whether an heir inherits an elder's loss decides whether later drawing undermines on the working reading. Both are Ren's reading choices and are not fixed by each step's relations. Invariance under renaming is also a check, in this representation, of the method requirement that separate naming must not smuggle in independent entities; it is not a proof of nonduality.

不含伦理谓词；改认只处理每步形成一一对应的情形，不处理分裂与合并；连续是一种同一的读法，不是同一的定义；两个连续定理各只有一个方向；More.unceasing_reidentified 只在普查、present 不重复与 Taking 之下成立，不说哪个形成生起；接续怎样读、工作读法是否让任期经由接续延续，属于 Ren 的读法选择；从关系推出同一的完整说明（物质、信息或组织的连续）没有给出；见证都是最小见证。 / Contains no ethical predicate; re-identification covers only one-to-one correspondence of formations at each step, not splits and merges; continuity is one reading of identity, not its definition; each continuity theorem has one direction; More.unceasing_reidentified holds only under a census, present without repetition and Taking, and does not say which formation arises; how to read succession, and whether the working reading lets a tenure continue through succession, are Ren's reading choices; a full account deriving identity from relations (continuity of material, information or organization) is not given; the witnesses are minimal.
